title: Detailed paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2a2a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a1a2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Palette body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='40' ry='30' fill='#d4a056'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='38' ry='28' fill='#e8b86d'/>
  <!-- Palette edge highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='35' ry='25' fill='#f0c880' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Dark hollow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#b8833c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#a07030'/>
  <!-- Thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Paint blobs around edge -->
  <!-- Red -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='38' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6b7a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Orange -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='29' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffc896' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Yellow -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='28' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#fff0b3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Green -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#2a9d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#6fd8ca' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Blue -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='52' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#457b9d'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#85b8d8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Purple -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='65' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#7b2d8e'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='63' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#b86fd0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Pink -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='71' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#e76f9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='69' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9dc0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Teal -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='69' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#3ec6a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='67' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#7ef0d4' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- White -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='57' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#f1faee'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Brown -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='46' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#8b5e34'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='44' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#c48a55' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Paintbrush handle -->
  <rect x='72' y='18' width='3.5' height='28' rx='1.5' fill='#c9a06c' transform='rotate(15 73 32)'/>
  <!-- Paintbrush ferrule -->
  <rect x='71' y='43' width='4.5' height='5' rx='1' fill='#b0b0c0' transform='rotate(15 73 45)'/>
  <!-- Paintbrush bristles -->
  <path d='M73 47 L78 56 L69 55 Z' fill='#e63946' transform='rotate(15 73 51)'/>
  <!-- Small paint drops -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#457b9d'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#e76f9e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#2a9d8f'/>
</svg>
